hero.title: Not ready to visit in person? Watch this Sunday.
hero.lede: Join us live on YouTube for Bible class at 9 AM and worship at 10 AM, or catch up on a recent message anytime.

video.liveSub: Streaming through Bible class and worship

live.title: Sundays from 9 AM
live.body: The stream starts with Bible class at 9 AM and stays on through worship, usually until about 11:30. You don’t need an account to watch.

recent.title: Recent sermons
recent.body: Every message is saved to our sermon playlist on YouTube, newest first.

visit.title: Watched online? Come in person.
visit.body: We’d love to meet you. Here’s what a first Sunday looks like.
